I am a postdoctoral researcher currently working on understanding and predicting the population-level responses of small carnivores to human activity for the [DISCAR](https://www.fondationbiodiversite.fr/en/the-frb-in-action/programs-and-projects/le-cesab/discar/) synthesis project.

My research uses quantitative approaches to study the behavioural, reproductive, and population ecology of wildlife populations to understand the implications of human-mediated environmental change and species management for conservation. Motivated by the ongoing global extinction crisis, I focus on uncovering the mechanisms underlying species’ responses to environmental stressors to develop evidence-based strategies that promote species recovery and ensure lasting conservation outcomes.
